The '''Kro Var system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==History==
During the [[New Sith Wars]], a group of refugees that were fleeing the [[Ruusan campaign]] accidentally traveled to the system when their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] left [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at the wrong co-ordinates. They crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kro Var]] and the survivors organized themselves into clans. The system was later discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
